prompt:
Subject:
Faint profile in the dappled sunlight

Main Subject:
A close-up portrait of a woman in her 20s looking over her shoulder at the camera amidst warm dappled sunlight. Her face is positioned prominently slightly to the right from the center of the frame, highlighting her bright brown hair, amber eyes, and a thin white shoulder strap.

Person & Expression:
A clean, oval-shaped small face, horizontally wide and large amber eyes, soft parallel eyebrows, a thin straight nose, and glossy pale rose lips. With her body facing the left of the screen, she turns her face toward the camera, making direct eye contact with a calm, translucent expression and her mouth slightly open. Bright ash brown hair down to her collarbone, thin and sheer long bangs, with fine strands tucked behind her left ear and waving toward her shoulder. A small silver ring and a single-stone stud earring on her left ear.

Clothing & Pose:
A white delicate lace sleeveless top. Only the thin shoulder strap is visible on the left shoulder of the frame, and the neckline is placed outside the lower edge of the screen. A micro-fine pale gold chain around her neck with a small vertical pendant. The upper body is angled to bring the shoulder forward, with both arms and hands naturally lowered out of the frame.

Background & Lighting:
Vertical wooden pillars and warm-toned buildings form the background on the left, while a blue-gray window surface and dark green foliage are placed in the back right, blurred until their shapes dissolve. Warm afternoon direct sunlight enters from the top left of the screen, creating bright highlights on her bangs, forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, and shoulder. Soft shadows filtered through tree leaves are left on the left side of her face, adding a golden backlight to the hair outline.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 3:4 ratio. A close-up shot from above the shoulder to above the chest taken with a mid-telephoto camera at eye level. The crown of the head is placed near the top edge, and the face is positioned large and slightly to the right of the screen center, capturing the left ear and shoulder up to the hair on the right side. The hair on the right side and the chest are cut off at the edge and lower boundary. Sharp focus on both eyes, with a very shallow depth of field that heavily and softly blurs the background and hair tips.

Texture & Style:
A photorealistic real-life photo shot under outdoor natural light. High-definition rendering of fine skin texture and modest gloss, clear catchlights in the eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, transmitted light through each strand of bangs, the freshness of lips, and tiny reflections from metallic accessories. A clean and natural color palette with warm skin and hair tones subtly blended with the background blues and greens.

Negative:
Change to short black hair, front symmetrical composition.

promptZh:
主体：
斑驳阳光下的柔和侧影

主要主体：
一位 20 多岁的女性在温暖斑驳的阳光下回眸看向镜头的特写肖像。她的脸部位于画面中心偏右的显著位置，突出了她的 亮棕色头发、琥珀色眼睛 以及细细的白色肩带。

人物与表情：
干净的椭圆形小脸，横向宽大的琥珀色双眼，柔和的平行眉，纤细挺直的鼻梁，以及富有光泽的淡玫瑰色嘴唇。她的身体朝向画面左侧，转头看向镜头，眼神平静而通透，嘴唇微张，与镜头进行直接的眼神交流。亮灰棕色的头发垂至锁骨，留着轻薄的长刘海，几缕细发别在左耳后，向肩部自然垂落。左耳佩戴着一枚小巧的银戒指和一颗单石耳钉。

服装与姿势：
白色精致蕾丝无袖上衣。左肩仅露出细细的肩带，领口位于画面下边缘之外。颈部佩戴一条极细的淡金色项链，挂着一个小巧的垂直吊坠。上半身微微倾斜以使肩膀前倾，双臂和双手自然下垂，处于画面之外。

背景与光影：
左侧是垂直的木柱和暖色调建筑，右后方是蓝灰色的窗面和深绿色叶片，背景经过虚化处理，形状模糊。温暖的午后直射阳光从画面左上方射入，在她的刘海、额头、鼻梁、脸颊和肩膀上形成明亮的高光。透过树叶过滤的柔和阴影投射在她脸部的左侧，为发际轮廓增添了一抹金色的背光。

构图与摄影：
垂直 3:4 比例。使用中长焦镜头在平视角度拍摄的从肩部上方到胸部上方的特写镜头。头顶靠近画面上边缘，脸部较大且位于画面中心偏右位置，捕捉了左耳和肩膀以及右侧头发的细节。右侧头发和胸部在画面边缘和下边界处被裁切。焦点清晰地对准双眼，极浅的景深使背景和发梢呈现出浓郁而柔和的虚化效果。

质感与风格：
在户外自然光下拍摄的写实照片。高清晰度渲染出细腻的皮肤纹理和适度的光泽感，眼睛里有清晰的眼神光，睫毛、眉毛、穿透每一缕刘海的透射光、嘴唇的鲜活感以及金属配饰上的微小反光均清晰可见。干净自然的色调，温暖的肤色和发色与背景的蓝色和绿色微妙地融合在一起。

负面提示词：
改为短黑发，正面对称构图。
